import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np
from poolfit import *
cp=np.load('carry_prov.npz'); wraw=cp['wraw'].astype(np.float64); mu0=cp['mu0'].astype(np.float64); s=float(cp['s']); sc=float(cp['sc']); wlin=cp['wlin']
P='bert.encoder.layer.0.'
Wv=W(P+'attention.self.value.weight').astype(np.float64); bv=W(P+'attention.self.value.bias').astype(np.float64)
Wo=W(P+'attention.output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bo=W(P+'attention.output.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
Vc=Wv[56:64]; print('Vc shape', Vc.shape, 'RES cols of Vc nonzero', np.abs(Vc[:,RES]).max())
# relation to wraw
for nm,cand in [('s*wraw',s*wraw.T),('sc*wraw',sc*wraw.T),('wraw',wraw.T)]:
    print(nm, np.abs(Vc-cand).max(), np.linalg.norm(Vc)/np.linalg.norm(cand))
print('bv[56:64]', bv[56:64].round(4), ' -s*wraw^T mu0', (-s*wraw.T@mu0).round(4))
print('Wo[RES,56:64]', np.round(Wo[np.ix_(RES,range(56,64))],4))
print('Wo[KEEP,56:64] max', np.abs(Wo[np.ix_(KEEP,range(56,64))]).max(), 'Wo[RES, other] max', np.abs(Wo[RES][:, 64:]).max(), 'Wo[RES,0:56] max', np.abs(Wo[RES][:, :56]).max())
print('bo[RES]', bo[RES].round(4))
print('wraw RES rows', np.abs(wraw[RES]).max(), 'wraw norm', np.linalg.norm(wraw), 'wlin norm', np.linalg.norm(wlin))
f=np.load('feats_drop46.npz'); M0=f['M0']
print('std of carry raw', ((M0-mu0)@wraw).std(0).round(4))
g1=W(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight')[RES]; b1=W(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias')[RES]; g2=W(P+'output.LayerNorm.weight')[RES]; b2=W(P+'output.LayerNorm.bias')[RES]
print('L0 LN RES', g1.round(3), b1.round(3), g2.round(3), b2.round(3))
